title: Great App, Shady In-App Purchases, Zero Customer Support.
body:
Love the app, but when I signed up for the annual subscription with a limited discount, it was never fulfilled. 

I reached out to customer support multiple times with my invoice, but no response since over a month. 

I'd like to give the developer the benefit of a doubt, but this seems like deliberate fake advertisement to convert users without actually fulfilling what they're promising.
author: Gamer.27

title: The best routine app ever
body: I just keep loving this app each day. You can make routines or use one already made for you.
author: Success Okodugha

title: Good app but poor support
body:
The app is very useful. But it seems developers are more concerned with adding social media features than addressing bugs and known issues. 

For example, if you colour in your home screen, using the iOS design options, the Routinery widget simply goes blank, no content visible. I’ve reported this bug twice and despite several updates it still persists. Just to be clear, this is a bug that makes the app non-usable under certain iOS settings. But developers have chosen to add yet another share option…
author: Harrrald
